title: The Mooberry Book Manager WordPress plugin through 4.16.2 does not perform any capability or nonce check in one of its…
description: The Mooberry Book Manager WordPress plugin through version 4.16.2 contains a vulnerability where one of its AJAX actions lacks capability and nonce checks. This flaw allows any authenticated user, including those with minimal roles such as Subscriber, to change the publisher assigned to any book, including those created by other users, and to create new book records. The absence of a nonce check also enables exploitation via Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) against any logged-in user.
